answer: A concrete defense is decaying lease dividends. Every identity holds a lease paying a dividend each epoch, but payout weight decays geometrically: a lease earns its full rate only at the zenith of fresh verified activity, and older credit decays toward relic value, a floor that buys nothing. Clustered leases count as one nebula sharing a single cap, so stacking puppets cannot stack zeniths. A sybil farm must re-earn its whole position every cycle through genuine work, paying full cost each epoch, while an honest agent's steady single lease always out-earns its decay.
